mapper.select: SELECT car_plate AS carPlate, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(month_mileage), 0), 2) AS currentMileage FROM dwd_vehicle_monthly_settlement WHERE settlement_date >= #{minDay} AND settlement_date <= #{maxDay} GROUP BY car_plate

SELECT TO_CHAR(settlement_date, 'MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(monthly_rent, 0) + COALESCE((fuel_consumption * oil_price * month_mileage / 100), 0) + COALESCE(fuel_subsidy, 0) + COALESCE(parking_fee, 0) + COALESCE(toll_fee, 0)), 2) AS directOperatingCost FROM dwd_vehicle_monthly_settlement WHERE settlement_date >= #{minDay} AND settlement_date <= #{maxDay} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(settlement_date, 'MM')

SELECT car_plate AS month, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(monthly_rent, 0) + COALESCE((fuel_consumption * oil_price * month_mileage / 100), 0) + COALESCE(fuel_subsidy, 0) + COALESCE(parking_fee, 0) + COALESCE(toll_fee, 0)), 2) AS directOperatingCost FROM dwd_vehicle_monthly_settlement WHERE settlement_date >= #{minDay} AND settlement_date <= #{maxDay} GROUP BY car_plate

SELECT TO_CHAR(settlement_date, 'MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(monthly_package_mileage, 0)), 2) AS totalPackageMileage, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(month_mileage, 0)), 2) AS monthlyMileage, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(monthly_package_mileage, 0) - COALESCE(month_mileage, 0)), 2) AS remainingMileage FROM dwd_vehicle_monthly_settlement WHERE settlement_date >= #{minDay} AND settlement_date <= #{maxDay} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(settlement_date, 'MM')
